categories.name: Agentic AI Threats
categories.summary: A significant focus this period on agentic AI frameworks being weaponized by threat actors. Microsoft published analysis on the ARTEX framework abuse, while Cisco Talos detailed tradecraft from agentic swarm attacks. These developments signal a maturation of AI-powered offensive capabilities that defenders must urgently address.

key_items.title: AI Threat Watch: Agentic Offensive Frameworks catalog

top_insights: Agentic AI has crossed a critical threshold: major security vendors (Microsoft, Cisco Talos) are now publishing dedicated threat research on weaponized AI agent frameworks, indicating these are active in-the-wild threats rather than theoretical concerns.
The emergence of specialized AI bug bounty platforms signals industry maturation in treating AI/ML systems as distinct attack surfaces requiring dedicated security testing approaches.
Coordinated AI swarm attacks represent a new paradigm in offensive operations, with documented tradecraft showing sophisticated evasion and coordination capabilities.
Global CERT coordination remains essential as AI-powered threats increasingly operate across jurisdictional boundaries.
